daily.today_energy: The scales are tipping toward authenticity today. Venus is giving you permission to drop the people-pleasing mask and lean into what actually feels true for you. Trust that vibe.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your realness right now, and honestly? That's way more magnetic than any attempt to be perfect. If you're coupled up, a small honest conversation could hit different today.
daily.career: Your natural ability to see multiple perspectives is your superpower rn. Situations that confuse others? You're seeing the full picture. Lead with that insight and watch things shift.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel a little buzzy—that's just creative energy looking for an outlet. Move your body in ways that feel good, not performative. Dance, stretch, whatever calls to you.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about recalibrating your inner compass, Libra. Mercury's moving through your sector of reflection, so trust the quiet moments—they're honestly trying to tell you something. Expect gentle shifts rather than dramatic turns.
weekly.love: Your vibe's magnetic but subtle right now. Whether you're coupled up or solo, focus on authenticity over performance. Real connections are brewing in spaces where you're just... you. Let people see the messy, unfiltered version.
weekly.career: The universe is low-key rewarding your behind-the-scenes efforts. This isn't the week to go big; instead, refine what's already working. Your attention to detail is your superpower—lean into it and watch doors open naturally.
weekly.health: Your nervous system's asking for gentleness. Slow down the pace where you can—think stretching, journaling, or just sitting outside. Your body's wisdom is louder than usual; listen to what it needs without judgment or pressure.
